description: This file defines the AceEditor class for interacting with Ace Editor instances in Playwright tests, including methods for setting, getting, clearing, appending text, focusing, and waiting for the editor to be ready.

classes.name: AceEditor
classes.description: A class for interacting with Ace Editor instances in Playwright tests, providing methods to manipulate and query the editor content.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes an AceEditor instance with a Playwright Page and a selector or locator.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Returns the Locator for the editor element.

methods.name: waitForReady
methods.description: Waits until the Ace Editor is fully loaded and ready for interaction.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the Ace Editor using the Ace API.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the current text content from the Ace Editor.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the content of the Ace Editor.

methods.name: appendText
methods.description: Appends text to the existing content in the Ace Editor.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus on the Ace Editor.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the Ace Editor is visible.
